User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the Kintsugi Portal system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of the user's profile image (optional).

DashboardMetrics.title: DashboardMetrics
DashboardMetrics.description: Represents key business metrics displayed on the dashboard.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DashboardMetrics entity.

date.description: Date for which the metrics are recorded.

totalSales.description: Total sales amount for the given date.

newCustomers.description: Number of new customers acquired on the given date.

averageOrderValue.description: Average order value for the given date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SystemSetting entity.

settingKey.description: The key or name of the setting.

settingValue.description: The value of the setting (can be a string representation of a number, boolean, etc.).

description.description: A description of the purpose of the setting.

AboutPageContent.title: AboutPageContent
AboutPageContent.description: Stores the editable content for the About Us page.

title.description: The main title of the page.

heading.description: The primary heading within the content.

body.description: The main body of text content for the page.

missionHeading.description: The heading for the mission statement section.

imageUrl.description: The URL of the image to display.

HomePageSettings.title: HomePageSettings
HomePageSettings.description: Stores the editable content for the Home page, like the background image.

backgroundUrl.description: The URL of the background image to display on the home page.

welcomeTitle.description: The main title on the home page.

welcomeSubtitle.description: The subtitle text displayed below the main title on the home page.

textAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the welcome text.

verticalAlign.description: Vertical alignment of the welcome text.

titleSize.description: Font size for the welcome title, as a numeric value (e.g., 5 for text-5xl).

footerTextLeft.description: Customizable text for the left side of the home page footer.

footerTextCenter.description: Customizable text for the center of the home page footer.

footerTextRight.description: Customizable text for the right side of the home page footer.

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Represents a parent inventory item category.

name.description: Name of the inventory item. Also used as the document ID.

description.description: An optional description of the item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the item was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the item was last updated.

InventoryVariant.title: InventoryVariant
InventoryVariant.description: Represents a specific variant of a parent inventory item.

variation.description: The specific variation of the item (e.g., color, size).

source.description: Where the item was sourced from.

quantity.description: The number of units available for this variant.

price.description: The selling price per unit for this variant.

costPrice.description: The cost price per unit for this variant.

warningLimit.description: The threshold below which the stock is considered low.

description.description: An optional description of the variant.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the variant was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the variant was last updated.

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: Represents an item in a user's shopping cart.

parentItemId.description: ID of the parent inventory item.

quantity.description: Number of units of the variant in the cart.

addedAt.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the cart.

discount.description: Optional discount percentage for this specific item in the order.

orderDate.description: Timestamp when the order was placed.

userId.description: The ID of the user who placed the order.

userDisplayName.description: The display name of the user who placed the order.

userEmail.description: The email of the user who placed the order.

shippingContactNumber.description: The contact number provided for shipping.

totalAmount.description: The total cost of the order.

discount.description: The total discount amount applied to the order.

deliveryFee.description: Optional delivery fee for the order.

packagingFee.description: Optional packaging fee for the order.

shippingAddress.description: The address where the order will be shipped.

cancellationReason.description: Reason for cancellation or decline, provided by an admin.

notes.description: Optional notes from the customer included with the quotation request.

PurchaseOrder.title: PurchaseOrder
PurchaseOrder.description: Represents a purchase order for acquiring inventory, including payment details.

date.description: The date the purchase order was created.

careOf.description: The person or department the order is for.

source.description: The supplier or source of the purchase order.

status.description: The current status of the purchase order.

agency.description: The agency or institution related to the PO payment.

paymentDate.description: The date the payment was processed.

amountDeposited.description: The final amount deposited into the bank.

bank.description: The name of the bank where the amount was deposited.

paymentStatus.description: The payment status of the purchase order.

entryType.description: Indicates if the PO was created via the standard system or as a manual payment entry.

totalAllocation.description: The total allocated budget for a manually entered PO.

totalExpenses.description: The total actual expenses for a manually entered PO.

PurchaseOrderItem.title: PurchaseOrderItem
PurchaseOrderItem.description: Represents a line item within a purchase order.

name.description: The name or description of the item.

quantity.description: The quantity of the item being ordered.

amount.description: The allocated cost per unit for this line item.

actualAmount.description: The actual cost per unit for this line item.

QuotationRequestItem.title: QuotationRequestItem
QuotationRequestItem.description: Represents a single item manually listed in a quotation request.

QuotationRequest.title: QuotationRequest
QuotationRequest.description: Represents a user's custom request for a quotation.

CustomerFeedback.title: CustomerFeedback
CustomerFeedback.description: Represents a customer's feedback and rating for a completed order.

rating.description: The star rating given by the user (1-5).

review.description: The optional text review provided by the user.

params.name: itemId
params.description: The unique identifier for the inventory item, which is the item's name.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support a business management portal with user authentication (Guest/Admin roles), a dashboard for metrics, and an admin panel for user and settings management. The structure emphasizes security, scalability, and debuggability, adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC, and QAPs.

**Authorization Independence:**  Authorization data is denormalized to avoid `get()` calls in security rules.  For example, admin privileges are determined by the existence of a document in `/roles_admin/{userId}`, avoiding the need to read user profile data during authorization.

**Structural Segregation:** Data with different access requirements is stored in separate collections (e.g., public vs. private data).  System settings, which require admin-only access, are stored in `/system_settings`, segregated from user-specific data. Inventory data is in its own collection with specific admin/guest rules, and variants are in a subcollection with admin-only access.

**Access Modeling:** User-owned data will be stored in `/users/{userId}/...`. Global roles are managed via existence checks in dedicated role collections (`/roles_admin/{userId}`).

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The structure enables secure `list` operations. The segregation of data based on access levels (e.g., system settings in a separate collection) ensures that listing operations can be secured without filtering based on document content.

**Denormalization Strategy:**  The role is denormalized to avoid reads in security rules. The dashboard metrics do not have user based authorization requirements so it will be under a main collection. The system settings require admin only access, which is achieved via role verification.
